samples.summary: New controller hand-rolls a private `assertSheetDocument` instead of the shared util that exists precisely to stop that duplication
samples.evidence: `packages/backend/src/api/v1/sheet-document.util.ts:22-27` states the rule explicitly: "Nine controllers carried a private copy of this method that differed only in the noun leading the message; the copies are what let the cells one go missing until #1019, so the logic lives here once and each controller supplies only its `subject`." Every sibling now delegates — e.g. `packages/backend/src/api/v1/tabs.controller.ts:51-58` calls `assertSheetDocument(this.documentService, 'Tabs', ...)`. `worksheet-images.controller.ts:39-50` reintroduces a private copy with its own inlined message string, so it will not follow the util when the shared guard or its wording changes, and `sheet-document.util.spec.ts` (which "pins every family's wording") does not cover it.

samples.summary: `duplicateTab` enumerates only 3 of the 6 optional `TabMeta` fields, silently dropping `lakehouseSourceId`, `lakehouseRef` and `asOf`
samples.evidence: `TabMeta` is declared at `packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-document.ts:121-131` with `kind`, `datasourceId`, `query`, `lakehouseSourceId`, `lakehouseRef` and `asOf`. The new `duplicateTab` copies only the first three (`if (source.kind !== undefined) ...`, `datasourceId`, `query`), so the other three are lost. Today the impact is masked: the controller refuses tabs with no `sheets` entry (`tabs.controller.ts:256-261`) and `applyDelete`'s own comment says a `datasource`/`lakehouse` tab has metadata and no worksheet — so lakehouse tabs cannot reach this path. It is still a hand-maintained field list that will drift the next time `TabMeta` grows a field, and it produces a `type`-preserving copy with its type-specific configuration stripped if that precondition ever changes.

samples.summary: Comment-map lazy creation (`if (!ws.comments) ws.comments = {}`) is the exact pattern `createWorksheet` documents as LWW-unsafe, and the API is now a second concurrent writer
samples.evidence: `packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-document.ts:158-165` seeds `comments: {}` at worksheet creation with an explicit rationale: "If the map were instead created lazily on first comment (`if (!ws.comments) ws.comments = {}`), two users adding the first comment concurrently would each create a fresh map and one — with its thread — would be dropped wholesale." The new sheet `createThread` arm does exactly that, as does the flat-root arm (`if (!root.comments) root.comments = {}`). It is bounded — `createWorksheet` seeds the map for any modern worksheet and `initialRoot: { comments: {} }` seeds the flat roots — so it only fires on legacy documents, which is the same narrowing the frontend PDF store notes at `packages/frontend/src/app/files/comments/pdf-comment-store.ts:123`. Worth knowing that the API adds a second party that can race that container into existence.

samples.summary: `extractMentionedUserIds` (and the `BodySegment` type) are re-exported from `mentions.ts` but no longer have any `src` consumer after `notify.ts` stopped importing them
samples.evidence: Grepping `packages/frontend/src` for these symbols returns only `mentions.ts` itself plus `CommentComposer.tsx`/`CommentBody.tsx`/`CommentSidePanel.tsx`/`OrphanedCard.tsx`, which use `parseMentionBody`, `mentionBodyToPlainText` and `MentionRef` — nothing uses `extractMentionedUserIds` or `BodySegment` any more, because `packages/frontend/src/components/comments/notify.ts` now delegates to `@wafflebase/sheets`' planner. The only remaining reference is `packages/frontend/tests/components/comments/mentions.test.ts:10`. Flagged as an out-of-step re-export surface; the knip lane is the thing that will actually decide whether it fails.
